lethal_vanguard.title: Lethal AI Vanguard

tempest_threat.description: Hostile AI receives a repeating Great Tempest power.

greedy.description: Each victory gives 25% more Gems than normal. You start with 2 less Ore.

veteran_economy.description: Each victory gives 30% more Ore than normal. Each run-shop price costs 20% more.

poor_logistics.description: Each victory gives 4 extra Ore, but each run-shop price costs 2 extra Ore.

generous_command.description: You start with 5 extra Ore, but each victory gives 20% fewer Gems than normal. Saved Gems are never removed.

blind_choice.description: +1 Ore per victory, but one mission offer hides its exact reward until launched.

glass_cannon.description: Player units deal 25% more damage but have 20% less durability.

overclocked_factories.description: Production time is 25% shorter, but player unit and structure costs are 20% higher.

black_market.description: Each stage has 4 extra Shop offers, but run-shop prices are 25% higher.

elite_force.description: Three guaranteed starters begin Veteran, but the other two guaranteed starter slots are removed.

no_safety_net.description: Each victory gives 1 extra Gem, but rerolls, difficulty assists, and Emergency Revival are disabled.

support_doctrine.description: Aid powers recharge 30% faster, but combat units build 20% slower.

war_economy.description: Start with 5 extra Ore, but every mission starts with 3,000 fewer in-game Credits.

narrow_intelligence.description: Mission victories give 30% more Ore, but each stage offers only 2 missions.

liquid_assets.description: Run-shop prices are 20% lower, but unused Ore disappears after each stage.

treasure_hunter.description: Challenge missions give double base Gems, but normal missions give 25% less Ore.
